//: Copy to seneschal/store/notion/mcp.json (gitignored). This is the MCP config the presence daemon FORWARDS to its headless `claude` sessions so they reach Notion with the SAME tool names the assistant's skills use (notion-fetch, notion-query-data-sources, notion-update-page, ...). The daemon finds it via store/config.json -> backends.notion.mcp_config; it is only forwarded when the active backend is `notion` (filesystem backends need no MCP). If you already added Notion at user scope with `claude mcp add` (see scripts/NOTION_MCP_SETUP.md), the daemon inherits it and you don't need this file at all.
//primary: Hosted Notion MCP (same tools as the interactive connector). Requires a one-time interactive OAuth: run `claude` once in this repo with this config and complete /mcp auth; the token is cached and reused by headless daemon spawns.
//alternative-stdio: If you prefer a non-interactive internal-integration token instead of OAuth, replace the block above with the stdio server below and set NOTION_TOKEN in the daemon env. NOTE: that server exposes the official Notion API tool names (API-*), which DIFFER from the assistant's skill tool names (notion-*) — the hosted server above is the better match; schema.md / mapping.md assume the hosted tool names.
